verdict.rationale: Zoho's first-party MCP server connects agents such as Claude to Books APIs, and the Books API documents reconciliation operations (create and list bank reconciliations, categorize transactions, bank rules with match filters). Zia claims anomaly spotting, and a customer quote cites month-end closures done through Claude. However, no documented agent workflow ties matching, exception flagging and close preparation together end-to-end: the MCP page's Books actions are listed as invoices, payments, expenses and reports, not reconciliation. Missing for 10: documented MCP or agent tooling specifically for bank reconciliation and matching, agent-driven exception flagging, a close-for-human-review handoff, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent reconcile a month end-to-end, matching transactions, flagging exceptions, and preparing the close for human review

citations.quote: Month-end closures, lead follow-ups, invoice tracking, all reduced from hours to minutes
Spot anomalies before they become problems
streamline the reconciliation process for swift month-end closing
